page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; a marginal note in italic at the right margin beside the first lines; catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: luberrima ex floribus siccatis rorismarini, Aceta ex floribus optima. saluiæ, lavendulæ, lilii convallium, sambuci, hyssopi, rosis siccis, & similibus, quæ vitam sanitatem q; prorogaturo, cumprimis verò politioris literaturæ studiosis, & ut uno dicam verbo, omnibus patribus familiâs tanquam pretiosissimum ad ingenii vires animiq; vigorem custodiendum thesaurum, u-nicè commendo. Præstant autem id fotu[?], olfactu & illitu circa tempora, oculos, os, nares & carpum. Crocata autem omnia præstātiora. Ad extremum, ut tandem lucubrationibus hisce vigiliisq; meis finem imponam, in condimentorum quoq; usum admitti, & aromata, ut gariophyllos, zinziber, piper, cinnamomū, corticé citri, cardamomū, crocū, macin, &c. non ignorandū est quib. suaviter salutariterq; cibi potusq; condiri solent, iisq; innoxiè maximoq; valetudinis commodo uti possum*, si moderatè & mediocriter adhibeantur. Immoderatū verō illorū, usumq; frequentiore, ipsum stomachū visceraq; int* omnia, præcipuè epar, intolerabili feruore incédere manifestū est, id q; sitis bibēdiq; avidi-tas indicat. Ubi pessimè sanitati vitæq; cōsulūt, q, dū ardoré illū vini ingētib haustib*, restinguere student, igněq; igni addētes, oleūq; flamis, ingéres in corpore cruciatus atq; tumult* excitāt, seq; ipsos ad liberali* avidiusq; bibendū, invitāt, proritā, atq; inflammant.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "fotu" (line 9) is uncertain and marked [?]; the sense suggests "tactu", but the letters seen are not clear. Page number "615" is read from a numeral with an old-style 5 and may be misread. Asterisks after possum, int, mult, liberali and haustib are printed marks, kept as they stand. Marginal note at right beside the first lines is in italic type. Spelling is kept as printed except for long s (rendered as s) and u/v and i/j normalisation. The word "cōsulūt" and "lūt" line 26 are read as printed; the line-end break "avidi-tas" and "u-nicè" keep their printed hyphens.
